intemerate.translation: a. 未受侵犯的, 未被玷污的, 纯洁的

intemerated.translation: a. 未经侵犯的；未被玷污的；纯洁的

intemerateness.definition: n. The state of being unpolluted; purity.

intemperance.definition:
n. the quality of being intemperate
n. consumption of alcoholic drinks
n. excess in action and immoderate indulgence of bodily appetites, especially in passion or indulgence
intemperance.translation:
n. 不节制, 过度, 酗酒
[医] 无节制(一般指酗酒)

intemperate.definition:
a. (of weather or climate) not mild; subject to extremes
a. excessive in behavior
s. given to excessive indulgence of bodily appetites especially for intoxicating liquors
intemperate.translation: a. 不节制的, 不温和的, 饮酒过度的

intemperately.definition:
adv. In an intemperate manner; immoderately;
   excessively; without restraint.
intemperately.translation: adv. 过度地, 无节制地, 放纵地

intemperateness.definition:
n. The state of being intemperate; excessive
   indulgence of any appetite or passion; as, intemperateness in eating or
   drinking.
n. Severity of weather; inclemency.
